market_boosters.baseline_warning: Frontend-only HTML/CSS/React TODO apps are heavily saturated at the entry level in India. Employers shortlist freshers who own end-to-end delivery from TypeScript UI to databases, tests, cloud deployment, and AI integrations.
high_value_addons: AI API Integration (LLM SDKs, RAG basics)

upgrade_path.title: Type-Safe Full-Stack Core (React + TypeScript + Next.js + PostgreSQL)
upgrade_path.description: Migrate your React skills to strict TypeScript and Next.js App Router backed by a Node/Express or FastAPI API and PostgreSQL schema with proper authentication.

upgrade_path.title: Production Reliability (Automated Testing + Docker + CI/CD)
upgrade_path.description: Add unit/integration tests with Vitest, end-to-end checks with Playwright, containerize with Docker, and ship automated deployments via GitHub Actions to AWS or Vercel.

upgrade_path.title: AI Feature Integration & Performance Profiling
upgrade_path.description: Integrate streaming LLM/AI APIs with rate limiting, caching, and Web Vitals optimization so your capstone solves a real workflow cleanly.

market_boosters.source: Naukri JobSpeak, LinkedIn Jobs India (0-2 yrs) & roadmap.sh

market_boosters.baseline_warning: Jupyter notebooks with scikit-learn fit/predict on clean CSV datasets no longer differentiate candidates. Hiring teams expect reproducible training pipelines, LLM evaluation harnesses, and deployed inference APIs.
declining_skills: Hardcoded OpenAI/Gemini wrappers with no evaluation
Manual hyperparameter guessing without validation splits

upgrade_path.title: Engineering Foundations (PyTorch + Clean Data Splits + Error Analysis)
upgrade_path.description: Move from notebook scripts to modular Python packages with reproducible train/val/test pipelines, confusion matrices, and baseline benchmarks.

upgrade_path.title: Applied GenAI & Evaluation (RAG + Structured Outputs + Evals)
upgrade_path.description: Build a domain-grounded RAG or classification service with automated evaluation metrics (precision/recall, faithfulness, latency, token cost).

upgrade_path.title: Production Serving (FastAPI + Docker + Monitoring)
upgrade_path.description: Wrap your model in a typed FastAPI endpoint, containerize it, add logging/fallback handling, and deploy a live testable demo.

market_boosters.source: fast.ai, NASSCOM AI Reports & LinkedIn Jobs India

market_boosters.baseline_warning: Basic Excel charts and simple SELECT queries face intense competition at entry level. Standing out requires production SQL optimization, automated transformation pipelines (dbt/Airflow), and distributed processing.
high_value_addons: dbt (Data Build Tool) & Tested SQL Transformations
declining_skills: Static BI dashboards without documented data contracts

upgrade_path.title: Warehouse SQL Mastery (Window Functions + Star Schema + Indexing)
upgrade_path.description: Design normalized OLTP and dimensional OLAP schemas and solve complex analytical queries using CTEs, window functions, and EXPLAIN plans.

upgrade_path.title: Automated ELT Pipelines (Python + dbt + Airflow)
upgrade_path.description: Build an automated pipeline that ingests public Indian or open datasets into PostgreSQL/BigQuery, transforms them with dbt models, and runs data quality tests.

upgrade_path.title: Scale & Streaming (PySpark + Kafka / Partitioning)
upgrade_path.description: Process multi-million-row event logs with PySpark or Kafka consumers, using partitioning and incremental loads to control cost and runtime.

market_boosters.baseline_warning: Collecting beginner cloud badges by watching slides without terminal/IaC practice fails technical interviews. Recruiters want Linux fluency, repeatable Terraform setups, CI/CD automation, and container debugging.
high_value_addons: AWS / Azure IAM, VPC & Serverless Basics

upgrade_path.title: Linux, Networking & Containerization (Docker + Compose + Reverse Proxy)
upgrade_path.description: Containerize a multi-service web/database app with healthchecks, non-root users, multi-stage builds, and Nginx/Caddy TLS routing.

upgrade_path.title: Automation & IaC (GitHub Actions + Terraform)
upgrade_path.description: Provision cloud networking and compute cleanly with Terraform and automate build, lint, test, and container image publishing via CI/CD.

upgrade_path.title: Orchestration & Observability (Kubernetes + Prometheus/Grafana)
upgrade_path.description: Deploy workloads on a Kubernetes cluster (kind/k3s/EKS) with resource limits, rolling updates, and dashboards tracking latency and error rates.

market_boosters.source: LinkedIn Jobs India, AWS/Azure Docs & roadmap.sh

market_boosters.baseline_warning: Running pre-built Kali Linux scripts without understanding TCP/IP, Linux permissions, or web code vulnerabilities leads to dead ends. Employers value engineers who can trace root causes, triage logs, and write secure fixes.
high_value_addons: Hands-on Web App Pentesting (Burp Suite, Secure Code Review)
SIEM Detection & Incident Triage (Splunk / Elastic / Wazuh)
declining_skills: Blind automated scanner dumps without remediation

upgrade_path.title: Systems & Protocol Foundations (Linux + Wireshark + OWASP Labs)
upgrade_path.description: Inspect real HTTP/TLS/DNS traffic in Wireshark and complete structured beginner security paths on TryHackMe to understand how exploits work.

upgrade_path.title: Offensive & Defensive Practice (Burp Suite + SIEM Home Lab)
upgrade_path.description: Audit a web app for XSS/SQLi/IDOR and write patches, or set up a Wazuh/Elastic lab to detect brute-force and privilege-escalation alerts.

upgrade_path.title: Cloud & DevSecOps Security (IAM Hardening + CI Scanners)
upgrade_path.description: Embed SAST, dependency, and container vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines and enforce least-privilege cloud IAM policies.

market_boosters.baseline_warning: Simple UI clones without local persistence, proper navigation, or automated testing rarely pass product startup screening. Modern mobile teams expect state management, offline sync, profiling, and clean architecture.
core_skills: Kotlin or Dart or TypeScript/React Native
high_value_addons: Jetpack Compose (Kotlin) or React Native TypeScript / Flutter
Performance & Memory Profiling (Frame Drops, Cold Start)
CI/CD App Signing & Release Automation (Fastlane / EAS)
declining_skills: Legacy Java AsyncTask & raw XML boilerplate
Global mutable state without lifecycle awareness

upgrade_path.title: Modern UI & State Discipline (Compose / Flutter / RN + TypeScript)
upgrade_path.description: Build a multi-screen app using declarative UI, typed navigation, and clean view-model / state separation.

upgrade_path.title: Offline Sync & Reliability (Local DB + Background Work + Tests)
upgrade_path.description: Add Room/SQLite caching so the app works smoothly on flaky Indian mobile networks, plus unit tests for repositories and state.

upgrade_path.title: Production Polish (Profiling + Auth + Release Pipeline)
upgrade_path.description: Profile memory and startup speed, add secure token storage, crash reporting, and automated build/release workflows.

market_boosters.baseline_warning: Textbook OS definitions or basic Arduino LED demos don't translate to core systems engineering jobs. Companies test memory ownership, concurrency bugs, Linux debugging tools, and protocol/firmware reliability.
high_value_addons: Modern C++ (RAII, Smart Pointers, C++17/20) & Rust
Multithreading, Mutexes, Lock-Free Queues & Async I/O (epoll/io_uring)
Embedded RTOS (FreeRTOS / Zephyr) & Hardware Buses (SPI, I2C, CAN)
Systems Profiling & Sanitizers (ASan, TSan, Valgrind, perf, GDB)
declining_skills: Turbo C / non-standard old C habits
Raw malloc/free without ownership discipline or sanitizers
Blocking polling loops in firmware without interrupts/RTOS

upgrade_path.title: Memory-Safe C/C++ or Rust & Tooling (CMake + GDB + Sanitizers)
upgrade_path.description: Build a non-trivial CLI tool or mini key-value store in Modern C++ or Rust while eliminating leaks and race conditions using AddressSanitizer and Valgrind.

upgrade_path.title: Concurrency & Low-Level I/O (Threads, Sockets or FreeRTOS Tasks)
upgrade_path.description: Implement a multithreaded HTTP/TCP server, custom shell, or multi-task FreeRTOS sensor controller with queues and interrupts.

upgrade_path.title: Performance Profiling & Systems Capstone
upgrade_path.description: Benchmark throughput/latency using perf, write automated unit/integration tests, and document memory layout and failure recovery.

market_boosters.source: GitHub Octoverse, Linux Kernel Docs & roadmap.sh
